arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Christopher Landau argued the people of Puerto Rico are the source of local law.
He stated this point is straightforward and central to the case.
Ms. Saharsky addressed the dual sovereignty test used in Double Jeopardy cases.
She explained why the Court has historically applied this specific test.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests whether Puerto Rico acts as a separate sovereign. This status allows both local and federal courts to try one person for the same act.
